site: MOXIR hall, Charentsavan. Owner's pin 40.406524, 44.636560 (inside span 3).
source: aerial survey (two Esri/Maxar captures 2020 and 2024, OSM, Microsoft ML footprints) and photo 007 crane metrology; read off pictures, not taped
layer: Layered LAST, after moxir-hall-dims-2026-09-28.json, moxir-hall-features-2026-09-28.json, moxir-hall-crane-dj-2026-09-28.json and moxir-hall-dims-2026-10-02.json. Nothing in those files is edited. The 10-08 site visit's tape layer (moxir-hall-measured-2026-10-08.json) goes after this one when it is filled.
frame: x along hall, y across, z up from floor; metres. lantern_segments_m: metres along the hall from its centre (the expansion joint), + toward the far end. Same frame as the 09-28 and 10-02 layers.

lantern_segments_m.range: each end +-0.8 (joint side) / +-0.7 (roof-edge side); segment length 41.3 +- 1.0; gap at the joint 11.5 +- 1.2
lantern_segments_m.confidence: medium: the two captures agree within +-0.8 m; ends read at the sunlit lantern top after the cast shadow (NW) and from the NE shadow band + 2.2 m (SE)
lantern_segments_m.source: docs/moxir/AERIAL_2026-10-07.md (table 'What to change', row 'Lantern segments'); scripts/place/rigs/moxir-aerial-2026-10-07.json result.lantern_from_joint_m and model_corrections.lantern_segments_m
lantern_segments_m.method: Esri World Imagery Wayback captures 2020-10-30 and 2024-08-22, deskewed to the hall axis (144.1 deg true), lantern ends read along four lantern edges, measured from the roof's joint line; scripts/place/aerial_measure.py

end_wall_in_from_grid_m.confidence: medium for the mean; the two ends differ (entry/NW 53.3 +- 0.5, far/SE 54.9 +- 0.6 from the joint line) and the model keeps them symmetric until the tape (survey item 14, docs/moxir/MODEL_VS_REAL_2026-10-07.md)
end_wall_in_from_grid_m.source: docs/moxir/AERIAL_2026-10-07.md (rows 'Bays / length' and 'End walls'); moxir-aerial-2026-10-07.json result.length_m 108.2 +- 0.6 and model_corrections.end_wall_outer_face_z_m mean 54.1
end_wall_in_from_grid_m.method: roof edge to roof edge along the hall in both captures (108.2, 108.25). The outer face sits at 108.2 / 2 = 54.1 from the centre. hall.py puts the inner face at L/2 + this key and the wall is 0.3 m thick, so 54.0 + (-0.2) + 0.3 = 54.1. The 6 m grid, 18 bays and the column axes stay; the end columns are clipped flush with the outer face (Soviet practice sets end columns 0.5 m in from the end grid line, with the wall on the line; that is NOT applied here because no picture shows it)

crane_bridge_bottom_h_m.confidence: medium (photo metrology, not taped). Per crane: far crane (76.2 m from the door) MEASURED by photo; near crane (49.2 m, over the DJ) ASSUMED the same type
crane_bridge_bottom_h_m.source: photo 007 (2026-09-29), far crane; restated here from moxir-hall-dims-2026-10-02.json (Emilya's #772 merge) so this layer carries the per-crane basis with the aerial corrections. The value does not change.
crane_bridge_bottom_h_m.method: fronto-parallel two-depth metrology (Criminisi et al. 2000), scripts/place/crane_height.py; Monte Carlo 5-95 % 7.69-8.24

per_crane.name: near (entry-end) crane, parked over the DJ
per_crane.basis: ASSUMED same type as the far crane (same runway, same yellow double-girder bridge with slotted side plates, photos 004/010/012/032)

crane_bridge_bottom_basis: ASSUMED-same-type: the NEAR (entry-end) crane, parked over the DJ, was never measured; it takes the FAR crane's 7.95 m (photo 007, 2026-09-29) as the same type of bridge (same runway, same yellow double-girder bridge, photos 004/010/012/032). Range 7.7-8.25 m. MEASURE on 2026-10-08 (moxir-hall-measured-2026-10-08.json).
measured by photo (not taped): 7.95 m (5-95 % 7.69-8.24), photo 007, fronto-parallel two-depth metrology (Criminisi et al. 2000), 2026-09-29

held.lantern_spans: the nave and its right (SW) neighbour — holds
held.lantern_h_m: 3.4 +- 0.4 from the 2020 shadow against 3.2 — agrees, UNVALIDATED method, unchanged
held.columns: photo 032: the owner's marks land on every model column of the left row (docs/moxir/PHOTO_ANALYSIS_2026-10-07.md) — confirmed, unchanged
held.joint_pair: photo estimate 1.2 m apart against the model's 1.0 — within the +-0.6 fit error, unchanged
held.right_row_y_columns: 8 Y-columns by eye (photo analysis) — consistent with the grid, unchanged

suspected.solar_roof: SUSPECTED: since 2024 (capture 2024-08-22) a solar plant covers the roof: ~40 panel rows over spans 1 and 4 and panels on or inside the lantern frames. The lanterns' daylight (the emissive 'skylight' material in hall.py) may be partly blocked; the model still draws the lanterns open. A dark lattice band along the nave's right row (x +12) and across spans 2-3 at the joint: stripped deck, cable trays or walkways, unknown. Owed to the 10-08 visit: one photo straight up at x +12 and one at z 0.

notes: 2026-10-07 aerial corrections (docs/moxir/AERIAL_2026-10-07.md): (1) lanterns 2.8 m too short — segments [[-46.9,-6.0],[6.0,46.9]] (were +-7.25...+-45.75); (2) end walls 0.7 m too far out at each end — outer faces +-54.8 -> +-54.1, overall 109.6 -> 108.2, via the new hall.py key end_wall_in_from_grid_m (0.5 -> -0.2); the grid is unchanged. (3) the crane girder underside 7.95 restated per crane with its basis.

Not read by hall.py, kept as its own record: moxir-hall-features-2026-10-07-photos.json (occupied-floor polygons, column checks, zone suggestions). hall.py reads none of its keys, so it is not in the --dims chain.
